name: Gaviti
summary: Gaviti is an AR platform that distributes invoices on a schedule, sends branded dunning emails, matches payments to invoices from remittance data or portal payments, and tracks aging in real-time reporting. Pricing is tailored to usage rather than per user and is requested through a form. The security page claims ISO 27001 and GDPR compliance, and does not claim SOC 2 for Gaviti itself.

facts.text: Gaviti says it distributes invoices to customers through multiple channels at set intervals or on triggers such as order fulfillment, and that dunning emails can carry company branding and purchase details.
Gaviti describes matching payments to invoices from the invoice numbers or references customers provide, and says portal payments are matched with 100% accuracy. That figure is a vendor claim.
The collections page says real-time reporting tracks aging analysis alongside DSO and collections efficiency, and that its workflows send reminders and escalations.
Gaviti's security page states ISO 27001:2013 and ISO 27701:2019 certification and GDPR compliance. Its only SOC reference is for the data center facility.
Gaviti's pricing page says the package is built around usage, not users, and lists unlimited users and workflows. It shows no dollar prices and offers a quote request form.

plans.name: Custom package
plans.notes: Tailored to usage, not per user

hiddenCosts: No fees are itemized on the pricing page, and card processing rates in the customer payment portal are not published.
